About Company

A dependable industrial supply partner.

Pooshan Tech Private Limited is a growing company serving industries requiring biodiesel, solvents, chemicals, tallow oil, and industrial raw materials. Our focus is to provide dependable sourcing, competitive pricing, timely coordination, and customer-focused business support.

We believe in building long-term business relationships by offering genuine assistance, transparent communication, and reliable product availability based on market conditions and customer requirements.

Business Activities

Three focused business verticals

Our operations are structured around manufacturing, supply, and sourcing support for industrial customers.

01
BD

Biodiesel BD100 Manufacturing

We manufacture Biodiesel BD100 for diesel-based applications with a focus on production quality, operational consistency, and dependable supply.

02
⚗

Industrial Solvents & Chemicals

We supply a broad range of industrial solvents, chemicals, and industrial oils including Methanol, MTO, MHO, Acetone, IPA Pure, Ethyl Acetate, DMF, Benzene, Toluene, LDO, HSD, and other materials as per requirement.

03
◌

Tallow Oil & Related Materials

We deal in tallow oil fats and support customers with suitable sourcing options based on product availability and business requirements.
